policy: Cash choice available from first completion; bone unlock thresholds remain separate.
correction: An earlier staged candidate gated cash at three without specific evidence. That restriction is removed before any deployment.

sources.facts: First two completions reward faction and coin, with additional bone options on the next three; the author states the families work similarly.
The first completion awarded 50 platinum. The report also interpreted XP and faction as exclusive; that interpretation remains unverified.

historical_limit: The general guide omits cash when summarizing early rewards. Specific period firsthand reward reports take precedence; exact early UI presentation is not recovered.
